name: South Enough 2018
information: The first ever competition in Santa Cruz, CA! To register, click on the 'Register' button at left (desktop) or near the top (mobile). Registration is completed after signing up on this website, and paying $25 via Stripe. **If your are a new competitor, please read the New Competitor Tab** All competitors are expected to be available to judge/scramble/run at all times. If you would like to volunteer to judge/scramble/run, please use the contact email provided on this page.
